text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
*sniff sniff*... Mmm, dear flowers,
what a lovely fragrance you have...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Just a little bit more here...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Machan? What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, an essay.
It is an assignment titled "An Essay on Family."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: An essay...? But you haven't written a single word.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is one of the preparatory steps for writing the essay.
The next step is waiting up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...... Understood.
Would you mind if I accompanied you for now?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh. You wish to watch Machan, do you?
Please feel free to gaze upon all sorts of Machans as you like~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is likely just part of her usual self-promotion...
Still, as long as I keep watch, I can handle any trouble if it arises.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Found it.
This ice cream, without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ice cream after flowers?
Just what are you planning to u—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
*munch munch*... Fufu.
It tastes of love.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You're eating it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*bubble bubble bubble...*)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. An exquisite result.
It is the fragrance of love, yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I watched over her through all of that, yet
nothing out of the ordinary occurred. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: There we go, everything is finally gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Gathered...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
*inhale*...—
Such a warm fragrance...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...And this flavor, too.
That scenery unfolds right before me...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It is love, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
......It's strange after all.
Something about her demeanor is different from usual—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Oh, look who it is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished planning the menu for <chrname>,
I stepped out for a coffee break, when...
choice_data_list: Is this... the aroma of black tea?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Are you curious about Machan's black tea as well?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I brewed quite a lot, so if you're interested,
I'll give you a special cup on the house.
You're interested, right?
choice_data_list: No, I was just about to have coffee...
What kind of tea leaves are those?
What kind of tea leaves are those?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I brewed quite a lot, so if you're interested,
I'll give you a special cup on the house.
You're interested, right?
choice_data_list: No, I was just about to have coffee...
What kind of tea leaves are those?
What kind of tea leaves are those?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Then come along, right this way to a seat.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Here is Machan's special branded tea.
Personally served by hand. An ultra-rare fan service.
You feel like becoming a fan now, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... What was I worrying about? She's just as she always is.
I must have overthought it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by her sheer persistence and the delicious tea,
I ended up being made to declare myself
a fan of Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, quite stubborn, aren't we?
Then allow me to make a presentation.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan's black tea is delicious.
And it is an ultra-rare treat you will seldom come across.
...You're starting to want a sip now, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... What was I worrying about? She's just as she always is.
I must have overthought it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swayed by her forceful sales pitch,
I decided to have some of her tea.
...And it was truly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is pure Darjeeling... but no no,
that won't do.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Brewing it yourself would be such a waste, you know.
Even with the same leaves, the true meaning lies
in experiencing tea presented by Machan!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... What was I worrying about? She's just as she always is.
I must have overthought it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I was treated to a cup of
Aston Machan's prized pure Darjeeling.
